title: 第133章 你，消失。
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“……四连请愿！我们也要帝皇赐福！”

“五连请愿！凭什么只给一连和三连赐福！！”

“六连请求同等赐福！我们打恶魔也很卖力！”

“七连申请帝皇之剑！哪怕一把也行！！”

“八连虽然没有正面接敌但是我们也需要发光武器！！”

“九连我们是忠诚的！！！”

“那个……十连……”

“你们这些后方的算什么？！帝皇啊！！看看我们二连！！我们二连和一连三连同时在突击啊！！！为什么只给一连和三连赐福略过了我们去！！！？我们也是您忠诚的战士啊！！！！！QAQ”

大家都在玩梗，只有林恩真的在兢兢业业正经赐福。

林恩站在防御工事上，远处的通讯频道里炸成了一锅粥。

其实林恩考虑过把这些技能都露出来会不会太引人注目了。

但是再一想本来就已经够引人注目了，大家都默认了他的活圣人身份，治疗加帝皇赐福加圣光大剑，都是板上钉钉的帝皇能力，不暴露三十日之类的技能存在的话，大不了就是坐实他的活圣人身份，不差这一点。

露出一部分，用可以暴露的技能遮掩不能暴露的，有助于他继续往上爬。

何况现在是在基里曼的主场作战，等会老十三还要亲自来，他赌一个老十三会保他。

大家都知道他是活圣人，审判庭也知道，但是因为老十三也知道，所以审判庭不能对他动手。

这个有点危险但又不算太过危险的身份刚好可以遮掩住他比活圣人更加危险的域外天魔的身份。

反正他目前露出来的都是帝皇的能力，谁能说他不忠？

你们被加强了。

上，都上！能上的都上！

金光一层叠一层，铺天盖地，把普兰迪姆灰白的平原染成了一片光辉灿烂的金色旷野。

林恩权杖一挥。

FOrtheEmperOr！！！

帝皇忠诚的战士们！全歼这些恶魔——！！！！

********

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"...Four companies are petitioning! We also want the emperor's blessing!"

"The fifth company is petitioning! Why only give blessings to the first company and the third company!!"

"The Sixth Company asks for the same blessing! We also work very hard to fight the demons!"

"The Seventh Company applies for the Emperor's Sword! Even one is fine!!"

"Although the Eighth Company did not engage the enemy directly, we still need luminous weapons!!"

"We are loyal to the Ninth Company!!!"

"That...Tenth Company..."

"Who are you people in the rear?! Emperor! Look at our second company! Our second company and the first and third companies are attacking at the same time! Why did you only give blessings to the first company and the third company and skip us!!!? We are also your loyal warriors!!!! QAQ"

Everyone is making jokes, but Lin En is really conscientious and giving blessings.

Linn stood on the fortifications, and the communication channel in the distance exploded into a pot of porridge.

In fact, Linn considered whether it would be too eye-catching to reveal all these skills.

But when I think about it, it is already eye-catching enough. Everyone has defaulted to his status as a living saint. Healing, Emperor's Blessing, and Holy Light Sword are all definite emperor abilities. If the existence of skills such as Thirty Days is not exposed, the worst he can do is to confirm his status as a living saint, which is not less than this.

Exposing a part and using skills that can be exposed to cover what cannot be exposed will help him continue to climb up.

What's more, they were fighting at Guilliman's home court, and Old Thirteen would come in person later. He bet that Old Thirteen would protect him.

Everyone knows that he is a living saint, and the Tribunal also knows it, but because Old Thirteen also knows it, the Tribunal cannot take action against him.

This somewhat dangerous but not too dangerous identity can just cover up his identity as an extraterrestrial demon that is more dangerous than a living saint.

Anyway, what he is currently displaying is the emperor's ability. Who can say that he is disloyal?

You are strengthened.

Come on, come on everyone!Get everything you can!

The golden light is layered on top of each other, overwhelming the sky, dyeing the gray plains of Plandim into a glorious golden wilderness.

Linn waved his staff.

FOrtheEmperOr!!!

The Emperor's loyal warriors!Destroy all these demons——!!!!
